parts.text: I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I plan and run the flights. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. My company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, though I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones.
